3. Arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the petitioner have been heard and the documents placed on record examined with his able assistance.

4. The petitioner filed Writ Petition No.2020/2021 challenging the decision to reopen the case of his absorption as Deputy Criminal Original No.159-W of 2021 Director General BPS-19. While issuing notice to the respondents on 09.06.2021 in C.M. No.01/2021 ad-interim relief was granted that no adverse action shall be taken against the petitioner. Transfer to another station does not amount to adverse action; it is exigency of the service. Under the facts and circumstances no violation of the order of this Court is made out.
5. In view of the above position, the instant petition is misconceived, hence dismissed in limine.
